zh: 巴塞尔大学（University of Basel）成立于1460年，位于瑞士巴塞尔市，是瑞士历史最悠久的大学，也是欧洲最古老的高等学府之一。作为一所顶尖公立研究型大学，该校在生命科学、医学、化学、药学、分子生物学、心理学等领域享有世界级声誉，科研成果丰硕，培养出多位诺贝尔奖得主。巴塞尔大学地处瑞士生物医药与化工产业核心区，与罗氏、诺华等国际知名企业深度合作，学术研究与产业转化结合紧密。学校规模精致、学术氛围自由严谨，注重基础研究与前沿探索，是欧洲生命科学与医学研究的重要中心之一，在全球学术界拥有极高的影响力。
en: The University of Basel was founded in 1460 in Basel, Switzerland. It is the oldest university in Switzerland and one of the oldest institutions of higher learning in Europe. As a top public research university, it enjoys a world-class reputation in life sciences, medicine, chemistry, pharmacy, molecular biology, psychology and other fields, with fruitful research achievements and many Nobel laureates among its alumni and researchers. Located in the core area of Switzerland's biomedical and chemical industry, the University of Basel has in-depth cooperation with world-renowned enterprises such as Roche and Novartis, closely integrating academic research with industrial transformation. With a compact size, free and rigorous academic atmosphere, the university focuses on basic research and cutting-edge exploration. It is one of the important centers for life science and medical research in Europe and has a high influence in the global academic community.
